description: A-share limit-up pool for a trade date, per stock: first/last seal time, final pct, seal amount (CNY) / volume (lots), `max_seal_amount` + `max_seal_time` (the day's peak seal), `broken_count`, `consecutive_days` (连板数), `board_count_within`, one-word-board flag, status (limit_up / broken), board class. Read `max_seal_amount / seal_amount`: peak >> current = 封单被吃掉, ≈ 1 = 封单从来就薄. ⚠️ The peak has no history before 2026-08-25 (0 / null = not recorded — never substitute `seal_amount`). `broken_count` = 当日开板次数, debounced: counts breaks below the limit lasting ≥30 consecutive seconds after a genuine intraday seal (auction touches never count); kept after re-sealing. ⚠️ Our own measure — not comparable with terminals' 开板次数, not with the `broken_count` of `limit_up_summary`, and not across 2026-08-25 (older dates used a per-snapshot rule). 行内提供 pct_change（兼容 final_pct）、turnover_rate、amount、main_net_in、super_net_in，资金流为当日最新已存分钟累计元；metrics_trade_date、quote_as_of、fundflow_as_of 标明日期和源时间，缺测为 null，历史不混入今日数据。 Rows include same-day `reason` / `concept_tags` / `attributed_at`, preferring LLM `leading_concept` while keeping `graph_leading_concept`; attribution outages are explicit. `prev_trade_date` and nullable `resumed_after_suspension` distinguish recorded suspensions from data gaps. Sort: consecutive_days → board_count_within → seal_amount, desc. Pre-open fallback applies.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

include.description: active = 排除 ST/退市（默认）; all = 全部

include_broken.description: true 时连炸板（status=broken）也一起返回；默认只返回当前封板 status=limit_up

trade_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for latest (pre-open fallback)

name: limit_up_pool
